help.text: Hello, how can I help you?

choices.text: I need help with my account.
I have a question about billing.

account_help.text:
Sure, what seems to be the issue with your
account?

choices.text: I want to update my email address.

billing_help.text:
I'd be happy to help with billing. What is your
question?

choices.text: I want to view my invoice.
I have a question about a charge.

password_reset.text:
To reset your password, please click on the
'Forgot Password' link on the login page and
follow the instructions.

update_email.text:
To update your email address, go to your
account settings and click on 'Edit Email'.

view_invoice.text:
You can view your invoices by going to the
billing section of your account.

charge_question.text:
Please provide more details about the charge
you have a question about.
